locator.precision: Google Maps selected named host-building point for Nishitetsu Chiyo-Kenchoguchi Building, 4-1-33 Chiyo, Fukuoka. The data center occupies space within this mixed-use building; the point is a labelled host-property locator, not an individual data hall, floor footprint, entrance or surveyed boundary.
locator.identity_review: The BSI certificate’s page 10 explicitly names Nishitetsu Data Center (Colocation) at Nishitetsu Chiyo-Kenchoguchi Building, 4-1-33 Chiyo. The owner’s official property page names the same building and address. An independent name-only Google Maps search selected this exact named building and address, with the owner property website; its original response associates the selected name, feature ID and coordinates. The DC is not inferred merely from the coincident headquarters address. The adjacent Lacleis apartment tower and map viewport are excluded. The certificate’s 2025 revision is retained as historical address evidence; current named-building public map evidence was retrieved October 15, 2026.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Google Maps supplies no measured horizontal accuracy or data-center-floor position; decimal precision does not imply survey accuracy.

status.summary: Nishitetsu Information System’s president describes current operations in two floors with about 250 racks and approximately 80% occupancy in the external-customer area. August 3 is the interview article’s publication date; the interview day is undisclosed. This records existing service, with no new opening or expansion inferred.
